# Alejo Araya

> Front-End Developer specialized in React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. Personal portfolio with professional experience, featured projects, and contact information. Spanish version available at /llms.txt.

I build modern, responsive, and functional interfaces, focused on delivering a great user experience. I currently work with React, TypeScript, JavaScript, and Tailwind CSS.

## About
- Front-End Developer with experience in technical support and web application development. I enjoy building clear, functional, and well-structured interfaces, paying attention to both user experience and code quality.
- Available for work.

- Web Developer — Red de Salud Tecnológica, RST (May 2023 - Jul 2024): Collaboration on user interface development, React component development, API integration, performance optimization, and code maintenance.

## Featured projects
- [Cachavacha ERP](https://cachavacha-frontend.vercel.app/): Web platform for digitizing and managing costume rentals. Centralizes customers, stock, bookings, and receipts in real time. Stack: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Redux Toolkit, React Router 7. Repo: https://github.com/raxtech-solution/Cachavacha-Frontend
- [RaxTech SPA](https://raxtech-landing-page.vercel.app/): Landing page for RaxTech, a tech solutions studio: websites, management systems, task automation, and AI assistants. Stack: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, React Router 7. Repo: https://github.com/raxtech-solution/raxtech-landing-page
- [Cachavacha SPA](https://cachavacha-landing-page.vercel.app/): Landing page for a costume rental business in Mendoza. Showcases the character catalog for themed parties. Stack: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, React Router 7. Repo: https://github.com/raxtech-solution/cachavacha-landing-page
- [Braided SPA](https://braided-landing-page.vercel.app/): Landing page for Braided: custom apparel printing and sublimation in Mendoza, for businesses, events, and individuals. Stack: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, React Router 7. Repo: https://github.com/raxtech-solution/braided-landing-page
